name: convertx
title: ConvertX
description: File converter in the browser for more than a thousand formats: pictures, documents, e-books, audio and video, using FFmpeg, ImageMagick, LibreOffice, Pandoc and others on this server. Uploaded and converted files are deleted after 24 hours. After deploying, open it and register: the first account is the only one unless you allow more below. The image is large (about 4 GB), so the first deploy takes a while.

variables.name: CONVERTX_JWT_SECRET
variables.label: Session secret
variables.description: Signs the sign-in sessions. Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: CONVERTX_HTTP_ALLOWED
variables.label: Allow sign-in over plain http
variables.description: Needed when you open it by this server's address and port. Turn it off when it is only opened over https

variables.name: CONVERTX_REGISTRATION
variables.label: Open registration
variables.description: Lets more people make an account after the first one
